# ZipGIF

> ZipGIF is a free, privacy-first online GIF toolbox. All processing runs client-side in the browser via WebAssembly (Gifsicle) — files are never uploaded to a server. No watermark, no signup, unlimited use.

## Tools

- [GIF Compressor](https://zipgif.com/): Compress GIFs up to 70% smaller with AI-selected settings, manual controls, and exact target sizes (e.g. 256KB for Discord).

- [Compress GIF for Discord](https://zipgif.com/compress-gif-for-discord): Verified Discord upload, emoji and sticker limits plus the target sizes that always work.

## Company

- [About](https://zipgif.com/about): What ZipGIF is and how client-side processing works.

- [Privacy](https://zipgif.com/privacy): No uploads, no file storage, no tracking of file contents.
